question: A nuclear reactor requires a thermal power output of $1000 \text{ MW}$. If the overall efficiency of converting this thermal power to electrical power is $30\%$, and each fission of $^{235}U$ releases $200 \text{ MeV}$ of usable thermal energy, calculate the number of $^{235}U$ atoms that must fission every second. (Use $1 \text{ eV} = 1.6 \times 10^{-19} \text{ J}$).
